derivation: neuter of comparative of (slightly) used for that of G2556 (κακός);
def: worse (as noun); by implication, less (as adverb)

occurrences.text: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
